recentItems.title: Love is Blind: Netherlands | Official Trailer | Netflix
recentItems.description:
Love Is Blind has finally arrived in the Netherlands. In this iconic dating experiment, singles who want to be loved for who they truly are date each other without ever seeing one another, talking only through a thin wall separating their pods. Once they get engaged, they meet face-to-face for the first time — and the real test begins. Over the next few weeks, they move in together, plan their wedding, and try to build a physical connection on top of the emotional one. When the big day arrives, will they marry the person they fell blindly in love with, or will reality get in the way? Hosted by Nicolette van Dam and Bas Smit, this addictive reality series raises the ultimate question: Is love truly blind?

Love is Blind: Netherlands arrives September 30. Only on Netflix.

Part 1: September 30
Part 2: October 7
Part 3: October 14
Reunion: to be announced

recentItems.title: The Diplomat: Season 4 | Official Trailer | Netflix
recentItems.description:
The award-winning series returns - October 15th, only on Netflix.

In Season Four of The Diplomat, two marriages threaten to eat each other alive. One catastrophic moment shatters the fragile peace Kate Wyler brokered between the US and UK, as well as the crumbling marriage she’s trying to save. While she fights to stem the bleeding, President Grace Penn and VP Hal Wyler’s conspiracy to steal Russia’s most powerful weapon hurtles the United States toward war. Kate and Todd, at best an uneasy pair, unite to stop the Grace-Hal alliance from upending the balance of power abroad and at home. Four Emmy nominees paint an unmissable portrait of two marriages: Keri Russell as Ambassador Kate Wyler, Rufus Sewell as Vice President Hal Wyler, Allison Janney as President Grace Penn, and Bradley Whitford as Todd Penn.

From creator, showrunner, and executive producer Debora Cahn, the Emmy and Golden Globe-nominated and AFI and SAG Award-winning series The Diplomat returns for a fourth season. Janice Williams, Alex Graves, Keri Russell, Peter Noah, and Eli Attie are executive producers. Also starring Ato Essandoh, Ali Ahn, and Nana Mensah.
